zh.title: 漢莎航空要求部分飛往法蘭克福航班增加載油
zh.summary: 漢莎航空要求部分飛往法蘭克福航班增加載油，稱目前不預期取消航班
body: 漢莎航空已指示營運部分飛往法蘭克福機場（FRA）的航班之飛行員攜帶額外航空燃油。報導稱，該機場燃油供應趨緊；漢莎航空表示，這項預防措施旨在減少航空公司抵達德國樞紐後加油的依賴，並維持航班運作可靠性。
路透社報導稱，漢莎航空已增加飛往法蘭克福航班起飛前的加油量。航空公司表示，目前不預期這一情況會造成航班取消。報導將增加載油描述為預防性措施，以降低燃油供應受限對營運的影響。

en.title: Lufthansa directs selected flights to Frankfurt to carry extra fuel
en.summary: Lufthansa directs extra fuel on selected Frankfurt flights and does not expect cancellations.
body: Lufthansa has instructed pilots on selected flights to Frankfurt Airport (FRA) to carry additional aviation fuel as supplies tighten at the airport. The airline says the precaution is intended to reduce its reliance on refuelling at the German hub and help maintain reliable flight operations amid disruptions to fuel deliveries.

A Reuters report said Lufthansa had increased fuelling before flights arriving in Frankfurt. The airline said it did not currently expect flight cancellations as a result of the situation. The additional fuel is described as a precaution intended to reduce reliance on local refuelling, rather than a response to an existing shutdown of airport operations.

zh.title: 印度航空規劃開航德里至大阪直飛航線
zh.summary: 印度航空規劃自2027年2月2日開航德里至大阪直飛航線，每週四班
body: 印度航空表示，將自2027年2月2日起開航德里至大阪的直飛航班，每週營運四班。大阪將成為該航空公司在日本的第二個目的地，航線將使用波音787-8 Dreamliner執飛。
印度航空表示，德里出發的航班將於深夜起飛，隔日上午抵達大阪；回程航班則於大阪中午前起飛，並於同日晚間抵達德里。該機型配置18個可平躺商務艙座位及241個經濟艙座位，每班可搭載259名乘客。

en.title: Air India plans four weekly nonstop flights between Delhi and Osaka
en.summary: Air India plans four weekly nonstop Delhi–Osaka flights starting 2 February 2027.
body: Air India says it will begin nonstop flights between Delhi and Osaka on 2 February 2027, adding Osaka as its second destination in Japan. The route is scheduled to operate four times weekly using Boeing 787-8 Dreamliners.

Flights from Delhi are scheduled to leave late in the evening and arrive in Osaka the following morning. The return service is due to depart Osaka before midday and arrive in Delhi that evening. Air India says the aircraft is configured with 18 lie-flat Business Class seats and 241 Economy Class seats, for 259 passengers per flight.

zh.title: 印度政府承諾融資支持ideaForge推進YETI無人機開發
zh.summary: 印度政府承諾融資INR1,510 million，支持ideaForge推進YETI開發
body: 印度政府已承諾向 ideaForge Technology 提供 INR1,510 million 債務融資，以推進 YETI 的開發。這筆資金將支持一項 INR3,020 million 計畫。政府表示，計畫目標是將 YETI 的技術成熟度從第 4 級提升至第 9 級，從經實驗室驗證的技術發展為在實際運作條件下獲驗證的系統。
YETI 正在開發為自主飛行器，目標是向偏遠軍事據點及其他難以抵達的地點運送物資。其設計結合垂直起降與固定翼飛行；來源列出的目標包括最高 200 公斤載荷及 200 公里航程。報導指出，這些仍屬開發目標，並非已經完成實際運作測試的能力。

en.title: India commits INR1,510 million to ideaForge for YETI drone development
en.summary: India commits INR1,510 million to ideaForge; YETI development is part of an INR3,020 million programme.
body: The Indian government has committed INR1,510 million ($16 million) in debt financing to ideaForge Technology to advance development of YETI. The funding will support an INR3,020 million programme. The government said the project aims to advance YETI from Technology Readiness Level 4 to Level 9, moving from laboratory-validated technology toward a system proven in operational conditions.

YETI is being developed as an autonomous aircraft to carry supplies to remote military positions and other difficult-to-reach locations. Its design combines vertical take-off and landing with fixed-wing flight. The stated targets include a payload of up to 200 kg and a range of 200 km. The report notes that these remain development objectives, rather than capabilities confirmed through completed operational testing.

zh.title: 美國空軍X-62 VISTA研討會聚焦自主作戰航空研究
zh.summary: 美國空軍八月在愛德華空軍基地舉辦X-62 VISTA自主航空研究研討會。
body: 美國空軍試飛員學校八月在愛德華空軍基地舉辦首屆X-62研究研討會。美國空軍表示，這場為期三天的研討會為自主作戰航空的未來研究奠定基礎。會中有美國空軍、DARPA、AFRL及MIT Lincoln Laboratory等單位簡報；空戰司令部戰鬥機中隊的作戰機組人員也分享飛行實務觀點，談及如何拉近飛行員信任與機器學習之間的差距。
美國空軍八月說明，HAVE HEAT及HAVE HOLIDAYS兩項加速測試計畫已於四月在VISTA上進行。較廣泛的Mission Systems Upgrade正在增加先進雷達、感測器與運算能力，以及現代化網路通訊。

en.title: US Air Force X-62 VISTA symposium sets foundation for autonomy research
en.summary: The Air Force held an X-62 VISTA symposium at Edwards Air Force Base in August.
body: The Air Force Test Pilot School campus at Edwards Air Force Base hosted the inaugural X-62 Research Symposium in August. The Air Force said the three-day summit “quickly set the foundation for future research in autonomy-enabled combat aviation.” Briefings came from the Air Force, DARPA, the AFRL, the MIT Lincoln Laboratory and others. Operational aircrew from an Air Combat Command fighter squadron also provided perspectives on bridging pilot trust and machine learning.

The Air Force detailed two accelerated test programmes, HAVE HEAT and HAVE HOLIDAYS, in August, saying they had been conducted on VISTA in April. The wider Mission Systems Upgrade is adding an advanced radar, expanded sensor and computing capacity, and modern network communications.

zh.title: 利雅德機場六架商用飛機受損 航空公司撤移機隊
zh.summary: 利雅德機場六架商用飛機受損，航空公司撤移價值最高 $4 billion 的飛機
body: Aerospace Global News報導，利雅德機場有六架商用飛機在攻擊中受損。報導指出，Saudia一架停放在第四航廈的空中巴士A320（ICAO機型代碼A320）於10月8日遭攻擊後起火並全毀；Riyadh Air一架波音787則於10月10日遭碎片擊中，機鼻受損。
報導稱，航空公司正從沙烏地首都撤移價值最高達 $4 billion 的飛機。根據報導引述的Flightradar24資料，利雅德機場地面上的飛機數量截至10月14日中午為38架，先前為134架。沙烏地 authorities 正調查攻擊如何穿透該國防空系統。

en.title: Six Aircraft Damaged at Riyadh Airport as Airlines Evacuate Fleets
en.summary: Six aircraft were damaged at Riyadh airport as airlines evacuated aircraft worth up to $4 billion.
body: Aerospace Global News reports that six commercial aircraft were damaged in attacks at Riyadh’s King Khalid International Airport. It says a Saudia Airbus A320 (ICAO type code A320), parked at Terminal 4, caught fire following an attack on 8 October and was destroyed. A Riyadh Air Boeing 787 sustained damage to its nose after debris struck it on 10 October.

The report says airlines are evacuating aircraft worth as much as $4 billion from the Saudi capital. Flightradar24 data cited in the report showed 38 aircraft on the ground at Riyadh by midday on 14 October, compared with 134 earlier. Saudi authorities are investigating how the attacks penetrated the country’s air defences.

zh.title: 空中巴士稱A220與A350加長型決策取決於商業論證
zh.summary: 空中巴士稱加長型決策須看商業論證；A350決策不會在2026年作出
body: 空中巴士表示，A220與A350加長型相關決策應在2030年前作出。商用飛機執行長Lars Wagner於10月14日在圖盧茲的媒體簡報會表示，決策將取決於可行的商業論證及董事會批准。
在A220方面，空中巴士表示，現有型號的產量提升優先於加長型決策，公司目標是在2028年達到每月生產13架A220。空中巴士寬體飛機主管Julien Puyou本週表示，A350加長型的決策不會在2026年作出。

en.title: Airbus Says A220 and A350 Stretch Decisions Depend on Business Cases
en.summary: Airbus says stretch decisions need viable cases; A350 decision will not come in 2026
body: Airbus says decisions on the A220 and A350 stretch projects should come before 2030. At media briefings in Toulouse on October 14, commercial aircraft chief executive Lars Wagner indicated that decisions would depend on viable business cases and board approval.

For the A220, Airbus Europe president Johan Pelissier told Aviation Week that production ramp-up of existing variants comes ahead of a stretch decision. Airbus is targeting 13 A220s a month by 2028. Airbus widebody chief Julien Puyou said this week that a decision on an A350 stretch would not come in 2026.
